labeling_note: Visual LLM workflow application supporting many providers; model-owned criteria are not applicable.

criteria.rationale: Node dependencies are declared in package.json.
A Dockerfile provides a containerized environment.
Flowise is a workflow application, not a project-owned dataset pipeline.
The application supports many model providers and does not own a model card.
The repository has a code license, but no project-owned model license.
Tests and CI workflows provide executable verification.
No training experiment is conducted by the workflow application.
Tests, CI and Docker build workflows are present.
Prompt-template nodes exist, but no prompt version or hash metadata is recorded.
No fixed sampling configuration is documented.
Flowise provides RAG-building nodes, but no project-owned reproducible index artifact.
The workflow tool does not ship a single agent trace artifact.
No evaluation dataset, split, or contamination protocol is documented.
Provider configuration is documented, but no reproducible cost or latency measurement is provided.
